summary: Your drive may meet resistance early. That pressure can become frustration, or it can become extraordinary stamina.
body: Mars square Saturn describes action shaped by limits. You may feel that effort takes more time, more control, or more permission than it seems to take for other people. Anger can build when movement is blocked, and fear can make you stop before you start. Yet this aspect also gives the capacity to work under pressure, master difficult skills, and keep going when quick motivation fails. The growth is learning to move steadily without turning every obstacle into a judgment against you.
gift: Endurance, strategic effort, controlled force, and the ability to finish hard things.
shadow: Frustration, suppressed anger, fear of starting, and pushing yourself until effort becomes punishment.
integration: Work with resistance instead of only fighting it. Pace, structure, and direct anger give your drive a path.
do: Break hard goals into visible steps
Practice direct action before resentment builds
